transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I'm here to help answer any questions you might have about your cataract surgery or your recovery. 

Do you have any questions for me today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for letting me know. Another question I have is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your surgery, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your care team.

If you need more supplies, your GP should be able to provide some for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Good to know. I'm also finding that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, some light sensitivity is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light or your eye is red and painful as well, that's not normal and we may need to check it further. 

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for explaining that. One last question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That depends on how long it's been since your surgery. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

How long ago was your surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My surgery was about a week ago. I understand it's normal for things to still be settling, so I'll keep an eye on it. Thank you for all the information, Dora. I don't have any more questions for now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great to hear. Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and don't hesitate to contact your care team if you have any concerns.
